# People Atlas 0.8.0 — Alpha

> [!WARNING]
> People Atlas 0.8.0 is an alpha version of the plugin. Its fundamental
> behavior is subject to change in future releases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.8.0 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
> Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

This release introduces a dossier-based People layout with stable identities,
central shared collections, and dossier-local profile photo selection.

> [!NOTE]
> Publishing People Atlas in the Community Plugins directory remains a separate
> step from this GitHub release.

## Changes

- Configure one **People root folder**; People Atlas derives `Profiles`,
  `Relationships`, and `Contact moments` beneath it.
- New people use readable dossiers backed by stable UUID identities. The first
  **Save** creates only the dossier and canonical profile note, and a later
  confirmed profile rename remains inside that same dossier.
- In **Edit**, the profile photo picker shows only supported images in the
  current canonical dossier or its descendants. Missing, stale, outside, or
  unsafe selections fail closed.
- People Atlas does not upload, copy, move, rename, delete, crop, or otherwise
  manage binary assets. Add an image to a dossier yourself, then choose it in
  **Edit** and explicitly save the profile.

## Breaking change / upgrade note

This release uses plugin data schema 8 and intentionally targets fresh
configurations and fresh vault organization. It does not migrate older settings
or data and provides no backward-compatibility path for older folder layouts.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
